w: "bheifeá" (you would be) calls for the conditional, "would". Dá (if) brings urú: dá bhfágfá. -fá means "you".
wg: Bheifeá: an modh coinníollach. Urú i ndiaidh "dá".

wg: Shíl mé: an modh coinníollach. Urú i ndiaidh "go".
